status_rule: After completing a task, set its check field to true. In future runs, only tasks with check false are eligible for work.
scope: Refine the home accent theme selector, selected-only active styling, and export button placement.
assumptions: Dark/system appearance mode is deferred to a separate future task.
Accent theme order is red, yellow, green, blue, purple, mono.
Theme buttons should be swatch-only with accessible labels and titles.

tasks.title: Expand and reorder accent themes
tasks.summary: Change accent choices to red, yellow, green, blue, purple, and mono in that order.
verify: All six data-accent-theme values exist in markup and CSS.
The JS accepted theme set includes all six values.
Invalid saved themes still fall back to blue.

tasks.title: Make theme buttons swatch-only
allowed_fields: Swatch-only sizing and active state styles
tasks.summary: Remove visible color names from the settings popover while preserving accessible labels.
verify: Theme buttons have no visible text labels.
Each theme button has aria-label and title.

tasks.title: Align selected-only active with accent theme
tasks.summary: Use the current accent color for selected-only active styling.
verify: selected-only active uses var(--accent) and var(--accent-soft).
No fixed yellow selected-only active color remains.

tasks.title: Move export button outside settings
tasks.summary: Move the 수정 JSON button back to the home title area outside the settings popover.
verify: The settings popover contains only settings controls.
The 수정 JSON button is visible on the home title row.
The existing export click handler still targets the same button ID.
